root.label: Court of Appeal quashes Julie Ann McIlwaine murder conviction

events.label: Court of Appeal quashes Julie Ann McIlwaine murder conviction

slots.name: conviction status
slots.sentence: A west Belfast woman who stabbed her abusive partner to death while he slept has had her conviction for murder overturned.

slots.name: minimum jail term
slots.sentence: McIlwaine, 35, who has been serving a minimum 12-year jail term, wept on the videolink from Hydebank Prison as the ruling was delivered.

slots.name: number of stab wounds
slots.sentence: Crossley, 38, was stabbed up to 10 times in the chest and abdomen as he lay sleeping beside the couple's young child at McIlwaine's former home in Dunmurry.

slots.name: next court date
slots.sentence: Adjourning the case until 16 October, she told prosecution counsel: "You have to come back to court on what steps you want to take."
